scope: Historic Dodger Stadium as standing, including the mapped bowl, separately roofed outfield pavilions, ballfield, hexagonal scoreboards, lights and center field plaza.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Los Angeles Dodgers records identify field distances of 330, 385, 395, 385 and 330 feet, and the low wall from the foul poles to the bullpens.
The pair of hexagonal display housings retains the original 1962 scoreboard shape.
The renovation retains the separate left and right field seating pavilions, restored club-seat colors and a field-facing plaza entry.
